Sell Your Tubes

We purchase single tubes, collections and estates.

Inherited a collection, downsizing, closing a repair shop or simply ready to sell? We buy vacuum tubes and related vintage electronics throughout New England and beyond.

You do not need to sort or test everything first.

Start with several clear photographs showing the whole collection and close-ups of tube boxes, labels and equipment. We can often determine whether an in-person review, shipment or more detailed inventory makes sense.

What we buy

Audio and amplifier tubes
Communications and ham-radio tubes
Rare and exotic tube types
Tube testers and test equipment
Tube sockets, boxes and parts
Radios, amplifiers and related electronics

Large estates and collections

We buy large groups as well as individual valuable tubes. Our buying process accounts for travel, testing, cleaning, organization, photography, listing, packing, customer support and resale risk. The goal is a fair, practical transaction for both sides.

New England pickup and nationwide buying

Based in Hudson, Massachusetts, we travel throughout New England and beyond for worthwhile collections. Smaller groups can often be shipped safely after an initial review.

Request an Evaluation

Helpful photos

Include wide shots, visible box labels, unusual large tubes, tube testers and any handwritten inventory lists.
